rv.q: Impressively designed and performed staging of Mel Brooks’ middling monster movie pastiche
This production of Young Frankenstein is a monstrous triumph - lovingly crafted, gloriously silly and performed with impeccable comic timing.
Young Frankenstein is alive with the easiest 5 star rating ever!
Hope Mill Theatre’s Young Frankenstein is a monstrous masterpiece gloriously camp, irresistibly funny, and packed with electric performances.
It's no fault of Nick Winston, who still manages to create a slick evening that's enjoyable despite the significant drawbacks of the material.
This comedy-filled twist on the hit movie is certainly a Halloween treat worth the watch.
